tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and lie at H=0.16–0.48. They support sink modulation but do not establish whether slow adaptation can overcome the positive response by the target horizon H=21.6. The slow-horizon probe directly tests that distinction.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At the observed short horizons, the slow term mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. Fits that agree on the pilot can disagree at H=21.6.
It can account for sink suppression but predicts no late-time reversal. The pilot does not test that distinction.
Finer trajectory sampling would help test a coupled memory ODE, but it does not directly target the long-horizon ambiguity.
